native.ros_profile: Reviewed RMW endpoint ABI or independently registered binding.
native.ros_middleware: Actual implementation family; ROS is not universally DDS.
native.ros_rmw: Actual loaded RMW identifier; installation default is not runtime evidence.
native.ros_transport: Actual path; QoS reliable does not select TCP and ROS does not force Ethernet.
native.ros_interface: Actual endpoint interface; actions comprise goal/result/cancel services plus status/feedback topics.
native.ros_role: Actual publisher/subscriber direction of this constituent endpoint.
native.ros_preset: Explicit requested proposal, not an immutable runtime setting.
native.ros_duration_encoding: Canonical normalized nanosecond policy values; unspecified0 differs from infinite.
native.ros_discovery_range: ROS DDS environment discovery; unsupported by rmw_zenoh.
native.ros_port_mapping: Actual DDS UDP mapping; only standard PB7400/DG250/PG2 has domain<=232.
native.ros_qos_compatibility: Actual middleware comparison result; WARNING is unresolved, not OK.
native.ros_executor: Actual client-library scheduler; conventional wait-set round robin is not FIFO under overload.
native.ros_callback_group: Actual group exclusion; multiple threads do not guarantee callback parallelism.
native.ros_zenoh_mode: Actual session mode, distinct router process.
native.ros_zenoh_shm_mode: Actual lazy allocation adds first-message latency; init moves allocation to session start.
native.ros_outcome: Observed endpoint/value processing result, not matching discovery alone.
native.ros_offered_history: offered Endpoint history; KEEP_ALL remains bounded by actual middleware resources.
native.ros_offered_reliability: offered Endpoint reliability policy, distinct underlying link protocol.
native.ros_offered_durability: offered RMW exposes VOLATILE or TRANSIENT_LOCAL, not full DDS TRANSIENT/PERSISTENT.
native.ros_offered_liveliness: offered RMW automatic/manual_by_topic only; no manual_by_participant.
native.ros_offered_deadline_mode: offered deadline policy mode. Deadline is publication spacing, not complete callback E2E latency.
native.ros_offered_deadline_ns: offered deadline normalized ns.0 unspecified; INT64_MAX infinite; INT64_MAX-1 best available only deadline/lease.
native.ros_offered_lifespan_mode: offered lifespan policy mode. Deadline is publication spacing, not complete callback E2E latency.
native.ros_offered_lifespan_ns: offered lifespan normalized ns.0 unspecified; INT64_MAX infinite; INT64_MAX-1 best available only deadline/lease.
native.ros_offered_lease_mode: offered lease policy mode. Deadline is publication spacing, not complete callback E2E latency.
native.ros_offered_lease_ns: offered lease normalized ns.0 unspecified; INT64_MAX infinite; INT64_MAX-1 best available only deadline/lease.
native.ros_offered_depth: offered actual size_t queue depth; depth0 means middleware default, not a verified zero-buffer endpoint.
native.ros_requested_history: requested Endpoint history; KEEP_ALL remains bounded by actual middleware resources.
native.ros_requested_reliability: requested Endpoint reliability policy, distinct underlying link protocol.
native.ros_requested_durability: requested RMW exposes VOLATILE or TRANSIENT_LOCAL, not full DDS TRANSIENT/PERSISTENT.
native.ros_requested_liveliness: requested RMW automatic/manual_by_topic only; no manual_by_participant.
native.ros_requested_deadline_mode: requested deadline policy mode. Deadline is publication spacing, not complete callback E2E latency.
native.ros_requested_deadline_ns: requested deadline normalized ns.0 unspecified; INT64_MAX infinite; INT64_MAX-1 best available only deadline/lease.
native.ros_requested_lifespan_mode: requested lifespan policy mode. Deadline is publication spacing, not complete callback E2E latency.
native.ros_requested_lifespan_ns: requested lifespan normalized ns.0 unspecified; INT64_MAX infinite; INT64_MAX-1 best available only deadline/lease.
native.ros_requested_lease_mode: requested lease policy mode. Deadline is publication spacing, not complete callback E2E latency.
native.ros_requested_lease_ns: requested lease normalized ns.0 unspecified; INT64_MAX infinite; INT64_MAX-1 best available only deadline/lease.
native.ros_requested_depth: requested actual size_t queue depth; depth0 means middleware default, not a verified zero-buffer endpoint.
native.ros_domain_id: Actual ROS domain;0 proposal does not prove isolation or matching remote domain.
native.ros_peer_domain_id: Actual communicating peer domain, not inferred from same topic name.
native.ros_participant_id: Actual DDS UDP participant index;120 can overlap next domain ports.
native.ros_discovery_multicast_port: Actual standard DDS discovery7400+250*domain, not Zenoh7446.
native.ros_user_multicast_port: Actual standard DDS user multicast base+1.
native.ros_serialized_bytes: Actual serialized ROS message bytes from selected type support; UDP65507 is not application maximum.
native.ros_serialized_bound_bytes: Actual codec and bounded-sequence limit, not generic Ethernet MTU.
native.ros_resource_max_samples: Actual endpoint resource limit, not KEEP_ALL infinite memory.
native.ros_threads: Actual executor threads; parallelism also depends on callback groups.
native.ros_zenoh_router_check_attempts: Actual startup check:0 infinite wait,negative skip,positive checks1s apart. Initialization may continue unmatched.
native.ros_zenoh_buffer_pool_bytes: Serialization recycling pool limit, not maximum message size; default8MiB.
native.ros_zenoh_shm_pool_bytes: Selected SHM optimization pool48MiB; real host capacity and fallback remain evidence.
native.ros_zenoh_shm_threshold_bytes: Actual power-of-two SHM threshold, not network MTU.
native.ros_zenoh_shm_threshold_bits: Actual log2 threshold; declares power of two exactly.
native.ros_age_ms: Observed message age under correlated clock source.
native.ros_freshness_ms: Actual application freshness requirement, distinct QoS lifespan.
native.ros_serialize_bound_ms: Actual source-qualified serialization worst-case, not a universal100ms.
native.ros_transport_bound_ms: Actual selected RMW/transport schedule bound including losses/retries/resources.
native.ros_executor_wait_bound_ms: Actual scheduler and load waiting bound, not inferred by thread count.
native.ros_e2e_bound_ms: Actual sum serialization+transport+executor wait+callback, not QoS publication deadline.
native.ros_avoid_namespace: Actual RMW avoid_ros_namespace_conventions; false preset applies ROS prefix.
native.ros_actual_qos_resolved: Actual endpoint QoS retrieved after creation; SYSTEM_DEFAULT is not resolved in a catalogue.
native.ros_interoperability_verified: Actual cross-RMW/edition/bridge interoperability; DDS compliance alone does not guarantee ROS compatibility.
native.ros_type_match: Actual type/representation/hash match; discovery alone is insufficient.
native.ros_discovered: Actual endpoint discovery/matching, not a default flag.
native.ros_zenoh_multicast: Actual Zenoh multicast scouting default false; ROS DDS SUBNET does not apply.
native.ros_zenoh_gossip: Actual Zenoh gossip discovery default true; router reachability remains unknown.
native.ros_zenoh_shm: Actual SHM enable flag; selected shipped configfalse until fully tested.
native.ros_zenoh_shm_capable: Actual compiled SHM feature and host support.
native.ros_zenoh_peer_shm: Actual peer SHM support; otherwise transparent network fallback.
native.ros_zenoh_shm_observed: Actual SHM path observed; enable flag does not prove no network fallback.
native.ros_value_accepted: Observed decoded and processed functional value under actual timing/evidence.
native.ros_security_verified: Actual endpoint security configuration; QoS matching is not authenticated identity.
native.ros_distribution: Actual ROS distribution/build source; latest rolling defaults do not overwrite deployed edition.
native.ros_binding_source: Actual constituent endpoints, underlying bearer and discovery binding.
native.ros_acceptance_source: Actual functional requirement, correlated trace and value acceptance evidence.
native.ros_registered_source: Source for separately registered transport/codec/discovery implementation.
native.ros_actual_qos_source: Actual endpoint QoS query after creation.
native.ros_compatibility_source: Actual middleware compatibility calculation/readback; Zenoh is not DDS Request-vs-Offered.
native.ros_type_name: Actual interface type name; generic IMAGE/STRUCT label is insufficient.
native.ros_type_hash: Actual ROS type hash; Humble and later Zenoh type-hash bindings do not interoperate automatically.
native.ros_topic: Actual fully expanded endpoint name; no substitution braces, doubled slash or numeric-leading token.
native.ros_peer_topic: Actual expanded matching endpoint name or explicit bridge mapping.
native.ros_static_peers: Actual semicolon-separated DDS static peer configuration; OFF still prevents discovery.
native.ros_zenoh_connect: Actual session connection locator; shipped localhost7447 is a proposal, not a known project address.
native.ros_zenoh_listen: Actual session listening locator; shipped localhost0 is not cross-host reachable.
native.ros_zenoh_config_source: Actual merged session/router config including environment overrides.
native.ros_clock_source: Actual correlation/time origin and synchronization uncertainty.
native.payload_bytes: Actual serialized ROS application byte count from selected type support. No UDP65507/EthernetMTU limit and no invented CAN8byte value.
